summary: Bound attention and delivery-presence retention and invalidate future prompts on runtime changes

replay.detail: Volatile attention snapshots rebuild normally; no claim replay is required.

rules.detail: Attention eligibility and delivery health rules are unchanged; incremental publication now follows current source and runtime state.

compatibility.detail: Terminal, non-person and undeclared attention sources and obsolete delivery incarnations are no longer retained. Live candidates keep negative dependencies and future prompts observe runtime invalidation before admission.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Restarting rebuilds the volatile publication caches from current store state.
